title: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to local privilege escalation via the SUID-root… (CVE-2026-84087)
description: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 contains a local privilege escalation vulnerability via a SUID-root podman_wrapper binary on the Collector appliance. A local attacker with low privileges can exploit insufficient argument validation in this binary to execute arbitrary commands as root, leading to full compromise of the Collector appliance.
